scripts.validate:
GATE_NAME=validate uv run scripts/render.py --check || exit 1; uv run scripts/plan.py validate || exit 1; uv run scripts/check-k8s-labels.py . || exit 1; n=0; for d in applications/*/overlays/*/*/ applications/*/addons/*/*/; do [ -f "$d/kustomization.yaml" ] || continue; echo "kustomize build $d"; out=$(kustomize build "$d") || exit 1; n=$((n + $(printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -c '^kind:'))); done; for f in applications/*/applicationset.yaml bootstrap/*.yaml applications/*/overlays/*/*/[dsehp]*.yaml applications/*/addons/*/*/[cs]*.yaml; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; out=$(kubeconform -strict -ignore-missing-schemas ${SERVICE_CRD_SKIP:+-skip "$SERVICE_CRD_SKIP"} -schema-location default -schema-location 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datreeio/CRDs-catalog/main/{{.Group}}/{{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json' -summary "$f"); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out"; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || exit 1; n=$((n + $(printf '%s
' "$out" | sed -n 's/^Summary: \([0-9][0-9]*\) resource.*/\1/p' | sed -n 1p))); done; [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || { bash scripts/gate.sh nothing validate '0 resources' 'run `devbox run render` and check that the system has components'; exit 1; }; bash scripts/check-policies.sh
scripts.test-fast: GATE_NAME=test-fast uv run scripts/render.py --check && uv run scripts/plan.py validate
scripts.secrets-scan: bash scripts/gate.sh files secrets-scan . && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 detect-secrets-hook --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.secrets-baseline: grep -qs is_line_allowlisted .secrets.baseline.json || detect-secrets scan --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret > .secrets.baseline.json; detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.ci: devbox run service-crds && devbox run validate && devbox run upgrade-check && devbox run security && if grep -qs '"ci-extra"[[:space:]]*:' devbox.json; then devbox run ci-extra; fi
